property_summary: For any callee that successfully accepts a low-level call, C.forward(...) always returns normally (the call succeeds) whereas the mutant requires the low-level call to fail; thus the reference never forces failure when the callee's fallback/receive succeeds, but the mutant does for such callees.
change_summary: Negate the success check so that the function requires the call to fail instead of succeed, altering state-observable behavior when downstream calls succeed.
